The '''Mertuen Forest''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. It was located west and south of the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Oniantae Hills]] and [[Smuggler Outpost]]. The forest also bordered the [[Marauder Mountain]] to the southwest and the [[Fersal Hills]] to the east.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of the [[Gondula]] tribe lived in the area.<ref name="SWG:ELV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mertuen Forest was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
